catalog.emptyMessage: Import Sentry/Dashcam clips above to build a local, searchable catalog.
catalog.noMatchMessage: Try clearing the search text or resetting a filter chip.

detail.emptyMessage: Choose a clip from the catalog to play it back, redact it, review event evidence, or reconstruct the incident timeline.

events.emptyMessage: Import metadata (event.json / folder), run local motion analysis, or connect telemetry in the Reconstruction tab to derive event candidates.
events.title: Event evidence

export.disclaimer: Exports are generated entirely in this browser. The still-frame export is a single redacted image, not a redacted video file.
export.title: Local export

import.description: Clips never leave this browser tab. Files are parsed and stored locally in IndexedDB, along with any redaction masks and notes you add.
import.title: Import clips from disk

page.noPersistence: Local storage is not persistent in this browser ({{reason}}) — imported clips will be lost when this tab closes.
page.subtitle: Local-only clip catalog, privacy redaction, and telemetry-synchronized incident reconstruction. Nothing leaves this browser.
page.title: Dashcam & Sentry Intelligence

reconstruction.description: Filenames carry no timezone. Adjust the assumed camera clock offset below if the reconstruction looks shifted.
reconstruction.firstLast: First: {{first}} at t={{firstAt}}s · Last: {{last}} at t={{lastAt}}s
reconstruction.lookbackNote: Requesting the last {{hours}}h of telemetry history from now to reach this clip. Older signal data may already have been pruned server-side.
reconstruction.noIncidents: No statistically significant telemetry changes were detected in this window.
reconstruction.noTimestamp: This clip's filename did not include a parseable capture time, so it cannot be aligned to telemetry history.
reconstruction.noVehicle: Select a vehicle above to align this clip with telemetry history.
reconstruction.offsetLabel: Assumed camera clock offset from UTC
reconstruction.outOfRange: This clip is old enough that server-side telemetry retention may not reach back this far.
reconstruction.title: Telemetry-synchronized reconstruction

redaction.description: Rectangles are stored as normalized coordinates and rendered over playback. Export produces a redacted still frame or a manifest — never a modified video file.
redaction.title: Privacy redaction masks
